correctness.rationale: For row n and column n+j far from zero, T* T uses the common output level n+ℓ+j and TT* uses the two output levels n and n+j. Their denominators yield the difference −(2ℓ+j)n^{-3}+O(n^{-4}); its coefficient agrees with the (−j)-th Fourier coefficient of −2 Re(conj(B) zB′). With D_nn=(n+1)^{-3/2}, the finite-band remainder after subtracting D T(σ) D has tail norm O(N^{-4}) and deletion costs rank ≤2N, hence s_j=O(j^{-4}) for the remainder. To verify the weighted counting step put ρ=t^{-1/3}. Compression below ερ costs at most ερ+O(1) eigenvalues per sign; compression beyond Rρ has norm less than t once R³>||σ||∞. The couplings across cuts cost only bounded rank for each fixed partition. In blocks between ερ and Rρ, freezing D gives operator norm error ≤t times O(η) for fixed ε and mesh η. Normalized traces of powers of each long Toeplitz section converge to symbol moments because only boundedly many boundary rows disagree. Apply this to continuous upper and lower ramps for the signed count threshold; for fixed ramps the block averages converge by a Riemann sum as η tends to zero. Removing the ramps is justified by the null planar threshold set ±x^{-3}σ=1, even for constant σ. The limit in x integrates to (±σ)_+^{1/3}. Min–max absorbs the remainder at any fixed relative threshold because its count is O(t^{-1/4}). The negative angular mean gives a strictly positive negative-side coefficient. The combined count inverts to the stated singular-value law, Schatten cutoff and harmonic-sum limit. A strictly negative σ gives a negative tail quadratic form since the D-conjugated tail error is O(N^{-1}); a positive arc gives infinite positive inertia. For the witness the diagonal contribution to Re(conj(B)C) is 644/100, and the off-diagonal contributions at π/3 are 135/100, −275√3/100, and −198√3/100. The resulting (779−473√3)/100 is strictly negative by squaring. Every pair has strictly positive lower bound (v−u)(mv−ℓu) for that radial expression. Thus the example is not at a critical endpoint. The packaged checker was inspected, not run; neither the analytical count nor the sign test relies on reported finite spectra.

evidence: The proportional-derivative vanishing criterion decisively differs from the strictly negative mean for nonconstant g. The full symbol evaluated at π/3 is positive, whereas each symbol after deleting one derivative coefficient is strictly negative.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Neither an unsigned law nor a two-term inertia classification separates the two signs for the all-polynomial adjoint self-commutator. Finite Toeplitz spectral distribution supplies a standard step but does not identify the bands of this operator.

evidence: The Wronskian summary gives the angular modulus of z³(g″h′−g′h″) and vanishing for proportional derivatives. Here the symbol is −2 Re(conj(zg′) z(zg′)′), with strictly negative mean even for one monomial.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Setting h=g in the Wronskian result gives zero, not the Hardy self-commutator. Taking adjoints cannot be achieved by another analytic symbol of this family: nonzero T_h raises degree and T_g* lowers degree. The Bergman predecessor also changes the Hilbert space and has two terms only.

originality.rationale: The supported distinction is the signed law for the adjoint self-commutator of every fixed polynomial Hardy Volterra operator, with its explicit third-order tail symbol, and the strict three-frequency witness. Credit older Volterra and Toeplitz methods, two-term Bergman inertia and the closely related cubic Hardy law for ordinary commutators. Similar third-order decay and identical Schatten exponents do not equate the operators or their signed counts.

value.rationale: Exact sign-resolved eigenvalue counts go beyond order estimates or ideal membership, and yield a computable logarithmic spectral residue. The explicit strict witness shows that checking every pair of frequencies fails to detect infinite positive inertia for a natural fixed-polynomial family. This is a structural obstruction, not an isolated numerical threshold search.
residual_risks: No quantitative remainder or classification on the critical zero-maximum locus.
